summary: CRITICAL BUG FIX VERIFIED: Text changes ARE preserved when switching between pages in BookEditor. Tested single page edit + switch (Page 1 -> Page 2 -> Page 1) and multi-page edits (Pages 1, 3, 5 with round-trip verification). All test markers were retained after page navigation.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix implementation is solid: Uses selectedPageRef (line 51) to always have latest selectedPage value
handlePageSelect (lines 664-700) properly syncs current edits to pages array BEFORE loading target page
useEffect (lines 650-661) keeps pages array in sync with selectedPage changes
The setTimeout(0) pattern in handlePageSelect ensures state update order is correct

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All page switch text preservation tests passed

context_for_next_testing_agent: BookEditor page switching bug has been fixed and verified. The fix uses a ref (selectedPageRef) to track current page and ensures edits are saved to pages array before loading the next page. Test by: 1) Login with test@printtest.com/printtest, 2) Go to My Books, 3) Edit any book, 4) Add text to a page, 5) Switch pages, 6) Return to original page - text should be preserved.
